hero.title:
Play, learn and compete
at your local chess club
hero.text: Weekly tournaments, coaching and social nights for players of every level, from first moves to titled competition.

gallery.title: What we offer
gallery.text: Everything you need to enjoy the game, whichever way you like to play it.

items.title: Rated tournaments
items.text: FIDE and ACF rated events through the year, run by qualified arbiters.

items.title: Coaching
items.text: Group lessons and training nights to sharpen your openings, tactics and endgames.

items.title: Junior chess
items.text: A friendly start for young players, with squads for those ready to compete.

items.title: Social nights
items.text: Casual games, blitz and good company every week. Everyone is welcome.

items.title: All levels
items.text: Beginners and titled players share the same boards and the same love of the game.

items.title: Fair play
items.text: Experienced arbiters and clear rules at every club event.

items.title: Regular events
items.text: A full calendar means there is always a next game to look forward to.

items.title: Community
items.text: Make friends, find training partners and represent the club in team events.

items.label: NEWS 01
items.title: Club championship
items.text: Our flagship event returns. See the schedule and enter online from the events calendar.

items.label: NEWS 02
items.title: Junior squad
items.text: Training for our junior squad starts soon, with places for new players.

items.label: NEWS 03
items.title: New members welcome
items.text: Come along to a social night and try the club before you join.

items.label: NEWS 04
items.title: Results and pairings
items.text: Follow every round of our tournaments as pairings and results are published.
